claims.disproof_condition: 條件：INNIO 之後一季的資料中心設備營收年減，或寫出資料中心訂單取消／延後。核查頻率：每季（INNIO 10-Q）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀 tech:gas_reciprocating_genset。
claims.statement: INNIO 10-Q (Q2 2026): data center revenue within Equipment revenue rose 97.0% to USD 232.4 million from USD 118.0 million a year earlier; INNIO is expanding genset production and containerization capacity for North American data center customers. Shipped revenue, not guidance.

source_doc.permission_basis: SEC EDGAR 公開申報（10-Q）；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取 EDGAR 申報日 2026-07-28。
source_doc.title: INNIO N.V. Form 10-Q（2026Q2，2026-07-28）：資料中心設備營收 2.324 億美元、年增 97%；擴充機組生產與貨櫃化產能以因應北美資料中心客戶

sources.quote: Data center revenue, within Equipment revenue, increased by 97.0% to $232.4 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 from $118.0 million for the three months ended June 30, 2025.

Our growth to date has been supported by a well-invested, assembly–focused asset base, and we are expanding capacity, notably genset production and containerization capacity, to meet accelerating demand, particularly from our North American data center customers.
